title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-08-21
headline: Personalised mRNA vaccine stops high-risk melanoma returning in a phase-three trial

questions.prompt: Who developed the personalised vaccine with Merck?
questions.hintKo: Merck worked with Moderna on the vaccine.

questions.prompt: What did the vaccine and drug combination do for melanoma patients?
choices: It caused the cancer to spread faster
It extended the time patients stayed cancer free
questions.hintKo: The combination kept patients cancer free for longer than the drug alone.

questions.prompt: When was the vaccine given to patients in the trial?
questions.hintKo: Patients received the vaccine after surgery.

questions.prompt: Where did researchers get the genetic information for each personalised vaccine?
choices: From a small part of the patient's tumour DNA
questions.hintKo: The genetic information came from the tumour DNA.

questions.prompt: Why do doctors still want caution about the results?
choices: The full results have not been released or peer-reviewed yet
The trial used only ten mice
The companies refused to name the drug
The story is about a typhoon
questions.hintKo: Caution is needed because the full results are not yet fully reviewed.

questions.prompt: How does the personalised vaccine teach the immune system to fight cancer?
choices: By cooling the whole body in ice
By instructing the immune system to recognise remaining tumour cells
By removing the entire immune system
questions.hintKo: It trains the immune system to recognise leftover tumour cells.
